en_title: GTA 6's Level of Detail Is So Extreme, Rockstar Built an Entire Scripted System Just for Sweat
subtitle: 每滴汗都有讲究
opus_summary: Rockstar为《GTA6》打造专门的脚本系统，根据角色活动时的用力程度决定出汗量。两位主角均受该系统影响，听起来其他角色可能也一样，跳舞或锻炼越卖力，出汗就越多。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games is of course known for its attention to detail, with previous Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption games raising the bar for realism. GTA 6 , though, looks set to go further than any video game before it, with a dedicated system that determines how much the characters sweat.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar向来以注重细节著称，此前的《侠盗猎车手》和《荒野大镖客：救赎》系列作品都提高了游戏的拟真水准。不过，《GTA6》似乎还将超越此前所有游戏，甚至专门设计了一套系统，决定角色的出汗量。

paragraphs.en: Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier said in a new video accompaniment to his making of GTA 6 article published this week, that Rockstar told him of a scripted system in the game that makes dual protagonists Jason and Lucia — or, it sounds like, any character in the game — exert different amounts of sweat depending on how much effort they’re putting into whatever activity they’re doing.
paragraphs.cn: 彭博社记者Jason Schreier本周发表了一篇关于《GTA6》制作过程的报道，并在新发布的配套视频中透露，Rockstar向他介绍了游戏内的一套脚本系统。这套系统会根据两位主角Jason和Lucia在各种活动中的用力程度，决定他们的出汗量。听起来，游戏中的任何角色可能都适用这套系统。

paragraphs.en: So, in a nightclub, for example, Lucia will sweat more if she’s putting a lot of effort into dancing. Similarly, the harder Jason works out, the more he’ll sweat. We might have already seen GTA 6's sweat system in action. In the Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look video released in August, we briefly see Lucia dancing in a nightclub, and there's a distinct glisten to her skin that suggests she's sweating. Or maybe it's a trick of the light.
paragraphs.cn: 比如在夜店里，Lucia跳舞越卖力，出汗就越多。同样，Jason锻炼越用力，出汗也越多。我们或许已经见过《GTA6》这套出汗系统的实际效果。在8月发布的《侠盗猎车手6》加长展示视频中，有一小段Lucia在夜店跳舞的画面，她的皮肤明显泛着光，看起来像是出了汗。当然，也可能只是光线造成的错觉。

paragraphs.en: This shows the incredible level of detail in GTA 6 — above and beyond any video game ever made — but it also helps explain why GTA 6 took so long to develop (eight years in terms of proper development work), and why it cost so much money to make ( not more than $1.5 billion, but no doubt the most expensive video game of all time ).
paragraphs.cn: 这展现了《GTA6》令人难以置信的细节水准，超越了以往所有游戏。同时，这也有助于解释，为什么《GTA6》的开发耗时如此之久——正式开发工作就花了八年——以及制作成本为何如此高昂。虽然成本不超过15亿美元(约合人民币100亿元)，但它无疑仍是有史以来制作成本最高的游戏。

paragraphs.en: Indeed, as the Bloomberg article reveals, Rockstar set up a new studio in Los Angeles packed with writers, producers, and directors, just to make NPCs.
paragraphs.cn: 事实上，正如彭博社的报道所披露的，Rockstar在洛杉矶设立了一家新工作室，配备了大批编剧、制片人和导演，专门负责制作NPC。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 has suffered a number of high-profile delays, each of which has been explained publicly as part of Rockstar’s mission to achieve video game perfection with this game. When you hear about the sweat that’s poured into it, you start to understand what this will actually look like when the game itself comes out.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》经历了多次备受关注的延期。每次延期，Rockstar都公开解释说，这是为了将这款游戏打磨至尽善尽美。听过这些关于汗水的细节，你便开始明白，等到游戏真正发售时，这份追求究竟会呈现出怎样的面貌。

paragraphs.en: With GTA 6 out next month, we’ve got plenty more for you to sink your teeth into, including our in-depth interview with Rockstar North's Rob Nelson in full, our report on what sounds like the end of Cyberleek , and some of the unusual marketing rockstar has put in place.
